review_scope: Exhaustive archive, section and paragraph completeness checks; targeted five-language editorial comparison of evidence boundaries, argument, conclusions and idiom. Not independent line-by-line historical certification of all twenty manuscripts.
notes: EP09 keeps aesthetic remembrance distinct from actually winning the title, and freedom of position distinct from the absence of collective discipline.

EP10 preserves the difference between documented political contacts and unproven mechanisms of match manipulation. The text does not infer individual players' complicity in repression from public appearances alone.

EP11 preserves the difference between sports sanctions, criminal conviction and Rossi's denial; later goals do not change the evidence. The source's closing phrase 永远没有终审 remains a rhetorical ambiguity in the inherited text, not independently certified here as a procedural claim about the case.

EP12's approved logical correction is applied to the Chinese and English shared page and all five supplied editions: the legitimate goal demonstrates skill not exhausted by the label cheat; it does not imply that someone who cheats cannot score a brilliant legitimate goal.

All other source HTML is protected byte-for-byte. The EP12 shared page currently exposes Chinese and English only; this batch does not add a new Traditional Chinese edition or claim a separate Traditional Chinese page was updated.
EP12 keeps the later revenge narrative distinct from an established premeditated purpose at the time of the match. No historical evidence has been added or upgraded to certainty.

ep09.ja.before: 最も流動的なサッカーは、結局、自ら一つの型となった。
ep09.ja.after: 最も流動的なサッカーも、結局は自ら一つの型となった。
ep09.ja.reason: Smooth the concluding cadence while retaining the paradox of fluid play becoming a fixed form.

ep10.de.before: vor einem Spiel, in dem alles auf dem Spiel steht,
ep10.de.reason: Remove the distracting Spiel/auf dem Spiel repetition without changing the political context.

ep11.es.before: Los artículos no pueden escribir todo el fútbol; los registros no pueden escribir toda una persona;
ep11.es.after: El reglamento no puede abarcar todo el fútbol; los registros no pueden abarcar a una persona entera;
ep11.es.reason: Make the writing-all-of-football/person calque idiomatic and identify articles as the rulebook, not journalism.

ep12.de.before: Doch vier Minuten später erzielte er dieses unanfechtbare Tor, rein bis in die letzte Faser, ein Tor, das kein Betrüger zustande brächte.
ep12.de.after: Doch vier Minuten später erzielte er dieses unanfechtbare Tor, rein bis in die letzte Faser. Das Können, das darin sichtbar wurde, lässt sich mit dem Etikett „Betrüger“ nicht erklären.
ep12.de.reason: Author-approved logical correction: skill exceeds a label; cheating does not make such skill impossible.

ep12.fr.before: Mais quatre minutes plus tard vient ce but incontestable, d’une pureté sans mélange, qu’aucun tricheur ne saurait inscrire.
ep12.fr.after: Mais quatre minutes plus tard vient ce but incontestable, d’une pureté sans mélange. Le talent qu’il révèle ne se laisse pas réduire au mot « tricheur ».
ep12.fr.reason: Author-approved logical correction; preserve the contrast without denying that one person can both cheat and display talent.

ep12.es.before: un gol que ningún tramposo podría marcar.
ep12.es.after: una muestra de talento que la etiqueta de «tramposo» no alcanza a explicar.
ep12.es.reason: Author-approved logical correction, synchronized with Chinese and English.

ep12.ja.before: 一点の濁りもなく、どんないかさま師にも決められないゴールだった。
ep12.ja.after: 一点の濁りもないゴールだった。そこに表れた技量は、「いかさま師」という一言では片づけられない。
ep12.ja.reason: Author-approved logical correction: a label cannot exhaust the player, without excusing the handball.

ep12.ko.before: 불순물 하나 없이 깨끗한, 어떤 부정행위자도 넣을 수 없는 골이었다.
ep12.ko.after: 불순물 하나 없이 깨끗한 골이었다. 그 골에서 드러난 기량은 ‘부정행위자’라는 말 하나로 설명할 수 없었다.
ep12.ko.reason: Author-approved logical correction, retaining both the clean goal and the distinct act of cheating.

source_corrections.reason: Explicitly approved correction of the claim that no cheater could score the legitimate goal. Change only this sentence in Chinese and English.

edits.before: a goal no fraud could ever score.
edits.after: a display of skill that the label "cheat" cannot explain away.
